scripts.test:build-base: astro build && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const expectations = new Map([['dist/index.html', ['/ChurchWebsite/_astro/', '/ChurchWebsite/uploads/', '/ChurchWebsite/contact']], ['dist/events/index.html', ['/ChurchWebsite/_astro/', '/ChurchWebsite/uploads/', '/ChurchWebsite/ministries/childrens-ministry']], ['dist/sermons/index.html', ['/ChurchWebsite/_astro/', '/ChurchWebsite/sermons'] ], ['dist/admin/upload/index.html', ['/ChurchWebsite/_astro/', '/ChurchWebsite/upload-sermon.php', '/ChurchWebsite/upload-event.php'] ]]); const addFirstGeneratedPage = (dir, checks) => { if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return; const generatedPages = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory()); if (generatedPages.length > 0) expectations.set(path.join(dir, generatedPages[0].name, 'index.html'), checks); }; addFirstGeneratedPage('dist/events', ['/ChurchWebsite/_astro/', '/ChurchWebsite/uploads/', '/ChurchWebsite/events']); addFirstGeneratedPage('dist/ministries', ['/ChurchWebsite/_astro/', '/ChurchWebsite/uploads/', '/ChurchWebsite/ministries']); if (fs.existsSync('dist/sermons')) { const generatedSermons = fs.readdirSync('dist/sermons', { withFileTypes: true }).filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory()); for (const sermon of generatedSermons) { expectations.set(path.join('dist/sermons', sermon.name, 'index.html'), ['/ChurchWebsite/_astro/', '/ChurchWebsite/uploads/', '/ChurchWebsite/sermons']); } } for (const [file, checks] of expectations) { const html = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); for (const check of checks) { if (!html.includes(check)) throw new Error(file + ' missing ' + check); } } console.log('Build output uses the configured /ChurchWebsite base path.');"
